# ziti_interfaces_v1_config (Resource)

Ziti interfaces v1 config Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ziti_interfaces_v1_config" "test_interfaces_v1_config" {
  name       = "test.interfaces.v1"
  interfaces = ["eth0", "eth1"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `interfaces` (List of String) The names of the network interfaces that a tunneler should bind to for this service.
- `name` (String) Name of the config

### Optional

- `config_type_id` (String) The Id of a config-type
- `tags` (Map of String) Config Tags

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated Time

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# interfaces v1 config can be imported by specifying the identifier.
terraform import ziti_interfaces_v1_config.test_interfaces_v1_config <ID>
```
